description: This file provides support for the Meta Llama API, especially for integrating with Llama's openai-compatible endpoint. It defines a configuration class LlamaAPIConfig that customizes openai parameter handling, based on the OpenAIGPTConfig class, to handle the specific limitations and capabilities of the Llama API.

classes.name: LlamaAPIConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for the Llama API that inherits from OpenAIGPTConfig and overrides methods to support Llama-specific parameter limitations and mappings.

methods.name: list get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns a list of supported OpenAI parameters for the Llama API, indicating limited support for certain features like response_format.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps non-default parameters to openai parameters, removing 'response_format' if it doesn't meet the 'json_schema' type requirement, reflecting Llama API constraints.

ctags.name: map_openai_params
ctags.signature: ( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
